svg.title: From 240 Screened Accounts to 20 Paid Accounts
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-annual-nested-cohort-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: From 240 Screened Accounts to 20 Paid Accounts; subtitle: Illustrative mature annual cohort supporting $515,000 in earned fees.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Every stage is a subset of the preceding account cohort, with one primary lane assigned per account to avoid double counting. Counts are planning assumptions, not observed conversion rates. Twenty paid accounts comprise ten drawback accounts, six tariff-refund accounts, and four settlement accounts. At an illustrative 30% fee, recoveries of $1,000,000, $500,000, and $216,666.67 produce $300,000, $150,000, and $65,000 in fees after cent rounding. Remaining submitted accounts are still pending, deficient, or unpaid at the measurement date.; caption: The cohort converts 8.33% of screened accounts into paid accounts; average earned fees are $25,750 per paid account.; stages: label: Screened accounts; value: 240 accounts; starting cohort; numeric value: 240.0; detail: Identify importer-exporter pairs, documented entry-error candidates, and businesses potentially inside an existing settlement class. Count businesses once, rather than counting each entry, shipment, or purchase as a separate prospect.; label: Authorized evidence access; value: 120 accounts; 50% of starting cohort; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Obtain written authority and usable source records from 120 of the 240 screened accounts. Exclude businesses whose records cannot be accessed through authorized channels or whose contracting entity cannot establish ownership.; label: Eligibility substantiated; value: 60 accounts; 50% of prior cohort; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Validate deadlines, claimant identity, statutory route, recoverable duty components, or settlement class membership. Remove prohibited duties, expired remedies, unsupported exports, and purchases outside the court-defined class period.; label: Complete packets submitted; value: 40 accounts; 66.67% of prior cohort; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Submit forty complete account packets through the required filing channel. Record submission acknowledgments and track all agency or administrator requests without treating submitted claim amounts as earned fee revenue.; label: Cash realized and fees earned; value: 20 accounts; 50% of prior cohort; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Recognize $515,000 in earned operator fees from paid recoveries, not from requested awards. Ten drawback accounts average $30,000 in fees, six refund accounts average $25,000, and four settlement accounts average $16,250.

text.title: From 240 Screened Accounts to 20 Paid Accounts
text.tspan: From 240 Screened Accounts to 20 Paid Accounts

rect.title: label: Screened accounts; value: 240 accounts; starting cohort; numeric value: 240.0; detail: Identify importer-exporter pairs, documented entry-error candidates, and businesses potentially inside an existing settlement class. Count businesses once, rather than counting each entry, shipment, or purchase as a separate prospect.

label: Authorized evidence access; value: 120 accounts; 50% of starting cohort; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Obtain written authority and usable source records from 120 of the 240 screened accounts. Exclude businesses whose records cannot be accessed through authorized channels or whose contracting entity cannot establish ownership.

label: Eligibility substantiated; value: 60 accounts; 50% of prior cohort; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Validate deadlines, claimant identity, statutory route, recoverable duty components, or settlement class membership. Remove prohibited duties, expired remedies, unsupported exports, and purchases outside the court-defined class period.

label: Complete packets submitted; value: 40 accounts; 66.67% of prior cohort; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Submit forty complete account packets through the required filing channel. Record submission acknowledgments and track all agency or administrator requests without treating submitted claim amounts as earned fee revenue.

label: Cash realized and fees earned; value: 20 accounts; 50% of prior cohort; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Recognize $515,000 in earned operator fees from paid recoveries, not from requested awards. Ten drawback accounts average $30,000 in fees, six refund accounts average $25,000, and four settlement accounts average $16,250.

text.title: Assumptions: Every stage is a subset of the preceding account cohort, with one primary lane assigned per account to avoid double counting. Counts are planning assumptions, not observed conversion rates. Twenty paid accounts comprise ten drawback accounts, six tariff-refund accounts, and four settlement accounts. At an illustrative 30% fee, recoveries of $1,000,000, $500,000, and $216,666.67 produce $300,000, $150,000, and $65,000 in fees after cent rounding. Remaining submitted accounts are still pending, deficient, or unpaid at the measurement date.
